title: Aoyagi Toya — After-School Assistance〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Welcome, Toya, Akito.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hello, everyone! We didn't realize that you'd all be coming!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Were you guys also practicing just now?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Does that mean you two also were?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, we just finished and decided to swing by for a break.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, Akito, Toya, you guys are helping with that Shibu Schools Fest thing too, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait, why do you know about that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was just telling them about how I'm gonna be in the musical.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
So, what are you two doing?
Are you guys gonna also be in it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry to disappoint, but I'm just helping move the equipment and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Wait, really?
But you're so good at singing...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Not that kind of singing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So only you and An are gonna be performing on stage, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, I won't be going on stage either.
I was asked to help write songs for it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, that seems like the perfect job for you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! It's bound to be good with Aoyagi's songs in it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I certainly hope so, but this is my first time working on a musical.
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm sure you'll do just fine, Toya.
Anyway, here are your usuals.

rows.Speaker: Toya & Akito
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, An just mentioned how her school isn't the only one that will be participating in this festival. Does that mean Kohane's school will be as well?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that's our understanding.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Come to think of it, are you doing anything for it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, I was invited to help, but I haven't made my decision yet...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I've been asked to help take photos for the official pamphlet, which I am really interested in doing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, that's great!
After all, you are a great photographer!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But based on what I was told, I won't be doing much other than taking a few photos.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which is why I'm wondering if there's anything else I can do to help...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In that case, would you be willing to listen to the songs I write? I'd like to hear your opinion.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really? That sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, but are you sure I'm the best choice? I don't know much of anything about musicals...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It might not help much to hear, but don't worry. I'm a complete beginner myself, so it's perfect.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, what matters most is that Kusanagi is leading the production of this musical.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The girl who was in your class last year?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What's she got to do with this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is my logic based on the information I have at hand.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: First, Azusawa, you've seen Kusanagi and Wonderlands×Showtime perform quite a number of shows.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh...
I knew I'd heard her name before somewhere. She's that girl.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Her name came up quite a lot when your class was making that film, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But this isn't just any kind of show. It's a musical. Sure, there's a lot of overlap, but...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The answer is a “quiet and peaceful forest”.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, where have I heard that before...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, when we went camping in order to achieve a shared vision...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A shared vision, as well as a shared vocabulary...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In other words, you may not have much knowledge of musicals, Azusawa, but through her shows, you may be able to understand Kusanagi's vision.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?! Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: B-But all I've done is go and watch a lot of her troupe's shows...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Again, this is just my train of thought.
I may in fact be completely wrong.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My goal is to make this musical as good as it can be by writing songs that fit seamlessly into Kusanagi's vision...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which is why I'd like you to help me, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The rest of you as well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Us?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Okay!
You want us to listen as members of the audience, yes?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, Toya, I'm not about to let you hog all of them! You guys are gonna help me practice and listen to me sing too, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course. I'm actually really looking forward to that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Me too. Feel free to practice here, even.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Awesome! But well, Toya has to actually write the song first!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I promise that it won't disappoint.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I'll need your help to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Sure.
Okay!
